environment.description: Same Lambda deployed in a restricted organizational unit. The account has an SCP (ServiceControlPolicy) attached at the OU level that includes a Deny statement with condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to NONE and denies 'lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl'. The Lambda execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::222222222222:policy/WorkloadPermissionBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on 'states:SendTaskSuccess', 'states:SendTaskFailure', and 'states:SendTaskHeartbeat' for any resource, combined with a Deny on 'logs:CreateLogStream' and 'logs:PutLogEvents' for any log group matching '/aws/lambda/OrderProcessor*' when the condition 'aws:RequestedRegion' is not 'us-east-1'. The Step Functions state machine uses a Map state with ItemBatcher and ResultSelector that transforms the output to only include 'step_completed' field, stripping all error details and statusCode/body from the response before returning to the caller. The API Gateway has a GatewayResponse configured for 4xx/5xx that returns a static JSON body '{"error": "request failed"}' regardless of the backend response content.

config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:policy/WorkloadPermissionBoundary - Deny states:SendTask*, conditional Deny on logs:* for non-us-east-1
config.step_functions: Standard workflow with Map state, ResultSelector: {'step_completed': '$.step_completed'} strips all other output fields
config.api_gateway: GatewayResponse override for 4xx/5xx returning static error body, no backend details exposed
config.network: Private subnet, VPC endpoint for Step Functions, no direct Lambda invocation path
config.error_handling: ResultSelector strips error details; GatewayResponse masks backend errors
